replies.reply_text: While HTTP/2 multiplexing cuts latency, long-lived TCP connections complicate traditional L4 load balancing. Integrating an L7 proxy like Envoy is usually necessary for true request-level distribution.
Fielding's emphasis on HATEOAS rarely survives high-throughput microservices, where teams trade hypermedia discovery for fixed gRPC schemas to minimize payload bloat and tail latency.
